details:
I would like to suggest adding a built-in text messaging feature directly inside VRChat (a mini in-game chat).

Why this would be useful:

While VRChat already has spatial voice chat, communicating quietly or quickly with friends currently requires opening SteamVR overlay, taking off the headset, or using external apps like Discord. An integrated text messaging system would make communication much smoother and more accessible.

Feature;

- Text only: Purely text-based (no voice or video calls needed).

- Direct Messages: Ability to send a quick text message to anyone on your friends list, regardless of which instance or world they are in.

- HUD: A simple, non-intrusive text overlay or menu panel accessible via the Quick Menu or Wrist Menu.

- Notifications: A subtle sound or UI notification when receiving a new message.

This feature would be a huge quality-of-life improvement, especially for muted users, people in loud worlds, or anyone who just wants to send a quick text to a friend without leaving the game context.

( Exemple; You send a DM to your friend via VRChat to know if they are busy if they are in Orange or Red.)
title: DM; built directelly INSIDE VRChat
